title: Mukhyamantri Amrutum (MA / MA Vatsalya) Yojana
administering_authority: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat
beneficiary_groups: Lower Income Families up to 4 Lakh
summary: Mukhyamantri Amrutum (MA) and MA Vatsalya provide cashless tertiary and secondary hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year to BPL families, families with annual income up to ₹4,00,000, and senior citizens in Gujarat.

benefits.description: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empanelled hospitals for critical illnesses including cardiology, oncology, neurosurgery, burns, poly-trauma, and renal diseases.
conditions: MA Vatsalya families eligible with annual income up to ₹4,00,000
Senior citizen families eligible up to ₹6,00,000 annual income

rules.explanation: Beneficiary family must be resident of Gujarat.
Family annual income must be up to ₹4,00,000 for MA Vatsalya (BPL families eligible automatically; senior citizen families up to ₹6,00,000).

required_documents.name: Income Certificate
required_documents.condition: Issued by Mamlatdar / Taluka Development Officer certifying income under ₹4 Lakh

required_documents.name: Ration Card
required_documents.condition: Proof of residence and family member roster in Gujarat

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.condition: Identity verification for all enrolling family members

application_steps.description: Visit registration kiosk at Taluka Civic Centre, District Hospital, Community Health Centre (CHC), or UTI-ITSL kiosk in Gujarat.
Submit income certificate, ration card, and family Aadhaar details.
Complete biometric capture (fingerprint and photograph) of all enrolling family members.
Receive the MA / MA Vatsalya health card with unique family identification number.

source_records.publisher: Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Gujarat
source_records.license_or_reuse_basis: Government Open Data / Public Domain official scheme guidelines

review_notes: Verified against official NHM Gujarat portal. In Gujarat, MA and MA Vatsalya have been integrated with PMJAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana - MA). Higher income limit for senior citizens (₹6 Lakh) and occupational exemptions documented as engine representation gaps.
